title: harness-classification/v1
description: The one record every Atlas hand-off roster surface is generated from. Each harness entry carries what the host actually showed, so a class can never outrun the observation behind it. Pinned by docs/decisions/ADR-079-generate-the-harness-roster-from-one-probed-manifest.md.

recorded.description: The staleness signal. A renderer compares these against the run that produced the surfaces it is checking.

classification.description: The four roster classes. Atlas launcher and tested local route are earned classes, and neither may be recorded without a client run. That rule is enforced by the probe's classifier, not by this document: the schema fixes the vocabulary and refuses an unknown name, and it will admit an earned name on an entry whose client_present is false and which carries no probe. Do not read validation against this schema as evidence that a class was earned.

probe.description: What the probe ran for this harness and what came back.

client_present.description: Whether the client itself was found on this host. A left-behind configuration directory is residue and is not presence.

client_version.description: The exact version the client reported, or the sentinel "unread" where a client was present and did not answer. Null only where no client was present to report one. Read version_read rather than comparing this value against the sentinel.

version_read.description: Whether client_version holds a version a client actually reported. False both where no client was present and where a present client did not answer, so no reader has to recognise the "unread" sentinel to tell a version from the absence of one.

auth_configured.description: Whether an authentication method is configured here. Kept separate from client_present so absence and a failed authentication never collapse into one verdict.

launcher_contract.description: What the client's current published contract offers, or the recorded reason it could not be read.

blocker.description: The exact named reason this harness could not reach an earned class. Null only where nothing blocked it.

testable_here.description: Whether the client was found on this host and an authentication method is configured here. This is client_present and auth_configured together, not a claim that a run succeeded: a present client that never answered is testable_here with version_read false. Read classification for what the run earned.

allOf.$comment: version_read is the field a reader is told to trust instead of recognising the sentinel, so the two may not disagree. A read version is a string that is not the sentinel.
An unread version is either the sentinel, where a client was present and did not answer, or null, where no client was present to answer.
